quotations.old_english: Ða byre onguldon gafulrǽdenne the children paid the tax

source_text: gaful-rǽden, -rǽdenn, e; f. A tax, tribute; census, tr&i-short;b&u-long;tum :-- Ða byre onguldon gafulrǽdenne the children paid the tax, Exon, 47 a; Th. 161, 16; Gú. 959 : 73 b; Th. 274, 7; Jul. 529 : Andr. Kmbl. 591; An. 296. v. gafol-rǽden.
